planets.name: TOI-561 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-561 with a 0.447-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-561 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-561. Its orbit and size follow Piotto et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname PIOTTO_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2020, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 0.4465697, pl_radj 0.12463221, pl_bmassj 0.00635563

quotes.title: TOI-561 b
quotes.card: TOI-561 b is an ultra-short period super-Earth exoplanet orbiting TOI-561, a Sun-like star.
quotes.introduction: The innermost planet in its planetary system, it orbits extremely close to its star, completing an orbit within 11 hours.
